stories.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
stories.take: Another $11B on top at a $1.25 trillion valuation — the AI money machine is not slowing down, even with a bubble debate raging around it.

stories.title: Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers
stories.take: The crypto-tracing firm got traced itself: attackers lifted credentials and tokens covering its entire customer base.

stories.title: Free Chinese AI Models Are Getting Scary Good at Hacking
stories.take: Open-weight Chinese models are closing the gap on offensive security fast — capability that used to cost money is now a free download.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned by Congress over Chinese espionage concerns
stories.take: Huang heads to the Hill as chip exports and espionage fears collide — expect the AI hardware fight to get political, fast.

stories.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
stories.take: Google picks up Crusoe's stalled Wyoming build — even troubled data-center projects are valuable real estate in the compute land grab.

stories.title: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in 2027
stories.take: The angular experiment gets an end date: Tesla will wind down the Cybertruck in 2027 after years of soft demand.

stories.title: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
stories.take: A humanoid tidied a real apartment — slow and supervised, but close enough to feel like the future arriving early.

stories.title: Fox Corp. Completes $22 Billion Deal for Roku
stories.take: Fox now owns the biggest TV streaming platform in the US — $22B buys it the living-room home screen and Roku's ad business with it.

stories.title: Pastor Talarico, 3 Billion Views, and $56 Million on Broadcast: How James Talarico’s Team Flipped Texas
stories.take: A case study in modern campaign media: 3 billion views of organic reach paired with $56M of old-school broadcast spend flipped Texas.

stories.title: Political Campaigns Spent a Near-Record $331 Per Voter, But Waste Forces Rethink
stories.take: $331 per voter and a lot of it wasted — campaigns are starting to ask what all that saturation actually bought.

stories.title: Amazon’s shopping agent now takes orders by text, with Sponsored Product ads in the replies
stories.take: Text Amazon's agent to shop — and yes, the replies carry Sponsored Product ads. The chat window is the new shelf.

stories.title: Creators see promise in Instagram’s long-form push, but question whether exposure is enough
stories.take: Creators like Instagram's long-form opening but want revenue, not just reach — exposure doesn't pay rent.

stories.title: e.l.f.’s stop-motion Christmas ad is a win for human creativity
stories.take: In an AI-ad flood, e.l.f. went hand-made stop-motion for Christmas — craft as the differentiator.

stories.title: Doncic's 53-point explosion pushes scoring average past 40 as Lakers roll
stories.take: Luka dropped 53 on Portland and is now averaging over 40 a night — a historic start, and the Lakers are rolling behind it.

stories.title: Warriors' Porzingis to 'step away' from NBA to prioritize his health
stories.take: Porziņģis steps away from Golden State to deal with ongoing health issues — no timetable, and another blow to the Warriors' frontcourt.

stories.title: In Cleveland return, James finishes with just eight points in 76ers' loss
stories.take: LeBron's Cleveland homecoming was a dud: 8 points in a 76ers loss, even as Philly sits 8-1 to start the season.

stories.title: Rivers: Giannis was playing games when trying to leave Bucks
stories.take: Doc Rivers says Giannis 'didn't want to be the bad guy' and was playing games during his Bucks exit — unusually blunt from a coach.

stories.title: Even Nikola Jokic might not be able to save these Nuggets
stories.take: Denver's start has been rough enough that even an MVP-level Jokić may not paper over the roster cracks.

stories.title: Lakers send little-used Bronny James to G League affiliate
stories.take: Bronny heads to the G League for minutes he wasn't getting with the Lakers — the sensible developmental move.

stories.title: MLB rumors: Tarik Skubal's market already hot, contenders eyeing Japanese slugger Teruaki Sato
stories.take: Free agency just opened and Skubal is already the name every contender wants — plus eyes on Japanese slugger Teruaki Sato.

stories.title: Ex-Guardians catcher Bo Naylor testifies in defense of Emmanuel Clase, Luis Ortiz in MLB pitch-rigging trial
stories.take: Bo Naylor took the stand for the defense in the Clase/Ortiz pitch-rigging trial — the betting scandal is now a courtroom story.

stories.title: Pujols to interview for Astros' managerial opening, sources say
stories.take: Albert Pujols, manager? Houston will interview the future Hall of Famer for its open job.

stories.title: Five under-the-radar MLB free agents who could make a big impact next season
stories.take: Beyond the headline names: five quiet free agents who could swing a contender's season.

stories.title: Group of retired MLB umpires, including Joe West, file lawsuit alleging they are owed more than $2 million
stories.take: Joe West and fellow retired umps sue MLB, saying their retirement plan shorted them more than $2M.

stories.title: D-backs' Carroll has elbow surgery, expected to be ready for spring training
stories.take: Corbin Carroll's elbow surgery is done and the timeline is friendly — Arizona expects him back for spring training.

stories.title: Trump names Stephen Miller his next chief of staff after major Republican midterm losses
stories.take: After the midterm rout, Trump elevates Stephen Miller to chief of staff — a doubling-down signal, with Miller pledging 'total devotion.'

stories.title: Schumer says Democrats will stop Trump from placing 'right-winger' on the Supreme Court
stories.take: Schumer draws the first line of the new Congress: no Trump pick gets to the Supreme Court bench on Democrats' watch.

stories.title: Democrats plan to widen their probes of fatal ICE shootings
stories.take: The new majority widens its ICE oversight to fatal shootings — investigations are the first real lever Democrats get in January.

stories.title: Latino voters propel Democrats to big wins with leftward swing
stories.take: The 2024 realignment reversed hard: Latino voters swung sharply back to Democrats and powered the wave.

stories.title: News Wrap: Judge blocks construction of Trump's triumphal arch for now
stories.take: A judge halts Trump's triumphal arch for now — the monument fight moves to court.

stories.title: Kraków shooting latest updates: five killed and more than a dozen injured, police say
stories.take: Breaking overseas: five killed and more than a dozen injured in a shooting in Kraków, Poland; police updates are still coming in.

stories.title: With death sentence clemency, Newsom takes another big political risk
stories.take: Newsom's death-row commutations are his biggest political gamble yet — victims' families are furious, and the legal fight over whether they stick starts now.

stories.title: LA’s newer, bluer wave: Nithya Raman leads way as city’s progressives make their mark
stories.take: Los Angeles just got bluer: Mayor-elect Nithya Raman leads a progressive sweep that reshapes City Hall — homelessness is the first test.

stories.title: Great America, the Bay Area's premier theme park, is closing for good. Here's when
stories.take: California's Great America is closing for good — the Bay Area loses its flagship theme park; the story has the final dates.

stories.title: $11.4 million in Nvidia cargo reportedly stolen in Oakland heist
stories.take: $11.4M of Nvidia hardware vanished between Oakland and Texas — AI chips are now heist-grade cargo.

stories.title: California’s new teen social media law challenged in court by Meta, TikTok and Google
stories.take: Meta, TikTok and Google sue to block California's teen social-media law — the state's biggest tech fight moves to federal court.

stories.title: Feds move to dismiss case over 20,000 California ballots after Supreme Court denied appeal
stories.take: The DOJ drops its push to toss 20,000 California ballots after the Supreme Court refused its appeal — those votes stand.

stories.title: AI Stockpocalypse, Anthropic Nears RSI?, Prediction Markets vs. Pollsters
stories.take: The answers: Anthropic 'near RSI' is not proven — METER found its model-improvement rate roughly doubled vs the Mar 2024–Oct 2025 pace, ~80% attributed to internal AI use, but Anthropic redacted much of the report and Roy is skeptical • Prediction markets mostly piggybacked polls/models, per Nate Silver's side of the argument; their edge is real-time visibility • Kantrowitz predicts Anthropic's IPO still goes out around Nov 19 near $1.3T • Midterms hit the build-out: Democrats took Congress, 38 jurisdictions restricted data centers, and the Nasdaq swung from a record bounce to a ~6% drop

stories.title: Election 'Blue Wave' & Your Wallet; Navigating AI-Driven Market Volatility
stories.take: Why voters feel behind: wages up ~3.1% against 3.7% inflation — even with a strong jobs day (165,000 added in October) • Democrats' wallet agenda: restore Obamacare subsidies, roll back tariffs, rein in the Iran war via defense spending; Social Security's cliff in ~3.5 years forces a benefits-vs-revenue fight • If Mississippi and Alaska both flip, Democrats land a 56-seat Senate majority

stories.title: AI broke the cybersecurity world. Now what?
stories.take: The answer, per Alex Stamos: the old security industry is over — rebuild core software in memory-safe languages (even rewrite the Linux kernel in Rust) instead of patching • Every company should AI-red-team itself in the next 90 days, before attackers do • Automate bug-fixing and first-tier defense with cheap small models, with hard limits on what defensive agents can do • For AI media, verify what's real cryptographically instead of trying to detect fakes • Context: AI now finds bugs and writes exploits in real time, and a chained breach went Fireworks → Cursor → ~5,000 companies

stories.title: How the Democrats Did It
stories.take: The answer: no single message — Democrats ran locally rooted candidates everywhere, united by anti-billionaire populism, anti-corruption, and a relentless affordability focus (prices, health care, data centers, vouchers) • Texas is the proof: Talarico's faith-based anti-billionaire run plus Hinojosa's anti-data-center campaign won the governorship and four of five redistricted House seats • Border counties swung massively — Cameron +44, Hidalgo +49, Webb +50 vs 2024 — on backlash to ICE enforcement • Same formula, local forms: Ossoff +18 in Georgia, El-Sayed by ~7 in Michigan

stories.title: Trump appoints new chief of staff after midterm defeat
stories.take: Trump replaces Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller after the midterm rout — elevating the immigration crackdown's architect signals no change of course • Tech shares steadied after Thursday's sharp falls, when Nvidia, SpaceX and Tesla lost trillions in value on fears a Democratic Congress threatens the AI build-out • Also: Paraguay impeachment moves, Qatar/Iran, and a mass wedding in Gaza

stories.title: The Happy Pod: Celebrating the wedding that never happened
stories.take: Bridget's wedding collapsed after her fiancé's medical crisis and coma — so 11 strangers who answered her Threads post traveled to Northern Ireland to celebrate the wedding that never happened with her • Her takeaway: community is there if you put yourself out there and get a little vulnerable • Also: a 25-year-old Slovak cancer survivor cleaning water

stories.title: Sony Says Next-Gen Console is On Schedule - Kinda Funny Games Daily 11.06.26
stories.take: Sony says next-gen R&D is on schedule, lifted its profit forecast 9%, and sold 2.6M PS5s last quarter — but never said what the schedule is • The hosts call fall 2027 impossible for PS6, with 2028 the earliest plausible date given the chip/memory crisis • Their pitch test: a PS6 needs 9/10 exclusives, not prettier puddles, to move ~97M PS5 owners • Also: Ratchet & Clank Ranger Rumble cancelled, and Silver Lake/PIF eyeing Unity after the ~$55B EA deal

stories.title: The AI Boom Is Running Out Of Easy Money
stories.take: Ed Elson's fine-print find: Anthropic's S-1 shows $895B in purchase commitments, nearly all compute — ~$70B due in 12 months and ~$450B by end of 2030, vs $19B spent this year • $437B of it is non-cancellable — more than Anthropic's entire valuation eight months ago • The headline numbers looked great (revenue +~1,200% to $33B, losses down ~75%), but four years after ChatGPT no pure-play LLM maker has shown it can make more than it spends

stories.title: Introducing ‘METRO’ From Serial Productions
stories.take: Serial's new NYC show Metro opens with the Diamond District: a viral TraxNYC brawl video that got tens of millions of views and more than doubled the shop's sales • Sarah Koenig's real question isn't whether the fight was staged — it's what's real vs performance anywhere on 47th Street, where the first salesman they meet gives his name as James Bond, with ID to 'prove' it • Trainee sellers must move $25,000 in five days, repeatedly, to earn commission — 'eat what you kill'

stories.title: Defense attorney questions LBPD,  LA's new city attorney, San Clemente seawall fixes— Evening Edition
stories.take: Defense attorney Scott Sanders accuses Long Beach PD of hiding an arresting officer's battery conviction for seven years and asks a court to dismiss charges — the DA's office says it didn't know either • Marissa Roy wins LA city attorney with a commanding lead • Coastal Commission approves a quarter-mile seawall to protect Orange County's coastal rail tracks in San Clemente

stories.title: OC coastal flood advisory, Alanis Morisette residency at YouTube Theater, LA Chocolate festival— Afternoon Edition
stories.take: OC coastal flood advisory runs through Tuesday: tides ~1.5 ft above normal, worst Sunday and Monday — officials say sandbags alone won't cut it in Sunset Beach and Huntington Harbor • Alanis Morissette's 'Butterfly with a Machete' residency is at YouTube Theater, wrapping Wednesday • Preview: the inaugural LA Chocolate Festival

stories.title: A working-class midterm mandate
stories.take: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore — re-elected by 30 points — calls the wave in many ways a 'Black and brown wave': Black and Latino voters shifting and taking control • Come January, 10% of US governors will be Black, up from three elected in 250 years before Moore • On affordability his prescription is 'move fast, no more studies' • He concedes Democrats under-invested in Florida near-misses (within ~2 points for Senate, ~1.5 for governor) — a generational miss, not one cycle

stories.title: SCOTUS After the Midterms, Social Media Lawsuit, Life Under Economic Pressure in Cuba
stories.take: Nina Totenberg: an Alito retirement to beat the clock is unlikely — he says he won't retire, Senate Republicans just got drubbed, and only ~20 legislative days remain • From Jan 3, Democrats with at least 54 seats run judicial confirmations likely until 2030, and any Trump nominee will have to answer who won the 2020 election • Also: Big Tech's lawsuit against California's teen social-media law, and life in Cuba under rising US pressure

stories.title: What’s News in Markets: AI Blues, Musk Under the Microscope, Housing Hope
stories.take: A whiplash week: the Dow soared 1,500+ points Wednesday, then Thursday's sell-off — the worst since last year's tariff turmoil — erased ~$2.5T and pushed the Nasdaq into correction; week: Nasdaq -3.4%, S&P -2.7%, Dow -0.9% • The midterms were a referendum on the AI build-out: Texas's incoming governor wants a data-center pause and a dozen-plus Ohio towns voted to restrict them • Chips got crushed: semis -12% for the week, Nvidia -9%, AMD -11% • Oil fell 13%+ to under $99 on hopes Democrats pressure Trump to end the Iran war
